name: Kamagiri Nobutatsu
source:
Nobutatsu is the father of [url=https://vndb.org/c73278]Kouta[/url] and is the opposite of his son. He is handsome and had success with girls in his high school days. He have a good relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c45206]Saya[/url], the childhood friend of his son. He knows her since ever and seems to likes her like a daugther.
He works until late in the night and Kouta sees him only for the dinner and is very pleased to meet and eat with a family-like again.

[spoiler]He as an affair with Kouta's childhood friend Saya.

The reason he doesn't reveal his relationship with Saya to his son remains a mystery.[/spoiler]
